main_idea: Warmup lifts Nemotron 3 Ultra's GDPval score from 35.3 to 46.7.
ideas: Warmup lifts GDPval score from 35.3 to 46.7
Warmup comes within 2.8 points of the teacher
AfterQuery office tasks drove the warmup gain
summary: Slogan headline, eyebrow, category tag, stat card, takeaway sentence, and footer repeat or pad a solid bar chart; the subtitle is wordy, and nothing essential is missing.
